description: Send what the person pays and earns where they live to Borgo's open community data (published rounded under CC BY 4.0, no name or address kept; an automated review holds amounts far from others' or the official figure). Without confirm it sends nothing and returns the draft with its privacy note: show both to the person. Call again with confirm true only after they said yes to these exact figures, and only figures they gave you as their own, never estimates or figures read on another site. The answer carries a removal code for them to keep.

confirm.description: true only after the person agreed to send these exact figures
